title: Explicit Minimal Surface Models in $\mathbb{R}^5$ via Holomorphic Null Curves
summary: We study explicit conformal minimal immersions into $\mathbb{R}^5$ obtained from holomorphic null curves in $\mathbb{C}^5$. Although the general correspondence between conformal minimal immersions in $\mathbb{R}^n$ and holomorphic null data in $\mathbb{C}^n$ is classical, our aim here is different. We isolate the five-dimensional case and develop a concrete, self-contained account that emphasizes explicit formulas, integral-free constructions, and coordinate expressions suitable for computation and visualization.
